channel.description: This file is an XML representation of an issue

item.title: [IGNITE-5767] Web console: use byte array type instead of java.lang.Object for binary JDBC types
item.description: Schema importer should use [B query entity field type instead of java.lang.Object for the following SQL types: BINARY, VARBINARY and LONGVARBINARY.
item.summary: Web console: use byte array type instead of java.lang.Object for binary JDBC types

status.description: The issue is considered finished, the resolution is correct. Issues which are not closed can be reopened.

comments.comment: vsisko, can you please take a look on this ticket? As I understand you need change default type mapping modules/web-console/frontend/app/data/jdbc-types.json
Fixed an associated type for BINARY JDBC type to byte[].
vsisko, please add test for mapping BINARY type.
vsisko, will be better to add test to CacheJdbcPojoStoreTest, which can confirm support of following mapping in CacheJdbcPojoStore.
Implemented test for loading of BINARY column into byte array field.

Implemented string presentation of field type for query entity configuration.
Implemented possibility manually configure query and store fields with type byte[].

To test: Try to import domain models with BINARY columns:
Try to create domain models with byte[] columns for SQL query and cache store.
Generate project and fill binary data. Try to load caches and execute queries with byte[] columns.
